audit.why: This is a hard poke-vs-melee-engage matchup, and content win[] already scores Vel'Koz across every stage. diff=TRICKY / carryRating 7.5 already reflects that Poppy is at a structural disadvantage all game.
Spikes at level 2 (Q-W poke zoning the wave), level 6 (R channel outdamaging any all-in), and first item (poke item outpacing Poppy's passive shield regen) are already in content spikes[].

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart, breakdown.cooldowns/trading/early/mid, tradeGood/tradeBad, and two dosFull/dontsFull bullets were all left as the generic 'engage mirror' template (phases[N].side='Skill' on every row, 'chain'/'lantern' language that doesn't exist in Vel'Koz's kit) even though the content layer already has a correctly-researched poke-matchup writeup. breakdown.cooldowns also had no cooldown number at all.
audit.why: Vel'Koz has no engage chain — he is a ranged poke mage (Q Plasma Fission 7s CD, E Tectonic Disruption 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s CD knockup feeding his R channel). The template's 'bait the answer, start the chain' trading advice is backwards for a matchup Poppy loses by walking up.
audit.corrected: phases[0-6].side -> 'Vel'Koz' (matches win[] already); why rewritten per stage; cooldowns now cites Tectonic Disruption's real CD and Plasma Fission's 7s poke CD; trading/tradeGood/tradeBad, early, mid, and the two bled dosFull/dontsFull bullets rewritten to the actual poke lane.
